06634 ts@ba' (Aramaic) {tseb-aw'}

corresponding to 06623 in the fig. sense of summoning one's wishes;
      TWOT - 2953; v

AV - will 9, his will 1; 10

1) to desire, be inclined, be willing, be pleased
   1a) (P'al)
       1a1) to desire
       1a2) to be pleased
       1a3) to will (without hindrance) (of God)
